newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Komineft 1996 pre-tax loss jumps to 254 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Komineft 1996 pre-tax loss jumps to 254 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Company's full name is AO Komineft. Komineft is the main production unit and is mostly owned by oil holding company KomiTEK.

Figures prepared to Russian accounting standards on a cash basis. Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
